title: Race Road — Spartathlon
claims: The official route page describes a point-to-point course from Athens to Sparta, ranging from sea level to 1,200 m over tarmac road, trail and mountain footpath.
The official route page says aid stations are placed every 3 to 5 km and that each of the 75 race control points has its own time limit.
The route page divides the course into Corinth, Nemea, Lyrkia, Mountain and Nestani, Tegea and Sparta sections, with the Sangas Pass climb of about 960 m in 13 km and a summit at 1,100 m.
The route page ends the narrative at Sparta at 245.3 km, while the 2026 road book ends at 244.74 km; the two official pages do not use the same rounded distance.
The official GPX download is available from the route page.

claimVerification.note: Opening paragraphs: aid every 3–5 km; 75 control points.
Last paragraph says 245.3 km; road book row 75 says 244.74 km.
